title: Prove exact non-Frobenius rectangular tensor characters (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. For every finite field K of characteristic p, d >= 2 and n >= 2 which is not a power of p, the multiplication algebra A = K[x_1,...,x_d]/(x_i^n) has monomial tangent maps. Its complete automorphism determinant image and ordered covariant tensor-stabilizer image are

```text
N = n^d, E = n^(d-1)n(n-1)/2, S = n^(d-2)n(n-1)/2
D = H_E <(-1)^S>,  H_r = {a^r : a in K*}
Delta = {(u,v,w) : vw in H_N, uw in H_N, uvw in D}.
```

The proof gives three character equations and the exact number of special-linear orbits. The variable-swap sign is necessary: at K=F3 and n=d=2, the exact covariant image is {(1,1,1),(2,2,2)}, while scaling alone misses the latter triple. Nonlinear lifts contribute no further character.

This settles a non-Frobenius part of the nilpotent-algebra question in [PR5252](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5252). Credit Ali Romman / PR5316 and PR5459, Armin Pourshafeie / PR5656 and PR5663, David Ganz and the retained tensor-atlas lineage for the distinct predecessor interfaces. The radical filtration, elementary binomial identity and unital isotopy normalization are classical. No predecessor result is audited and no global literature-priority claim is made. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before, the cited character interfaces cover one-variable truncations or multivariable characteristic-power cutoffs. This adds the different non-Frobenius tangent restriction and its complete determinant character.

Local CPython 3.12.15 normal and optimized checks pass with identical generated hash-bound reports:

- 138 literal attaining automorphisms in fifteen contexts, including F4 and F8; 232,714 basis-product identities.
- Complete 729-pair and 65,536-pair generator-image domains, accepting 72 and 2,048 automorphisms. Each accepted nonlinear lift has the determinant of its tangent substitution.
- 310 literal unit multiplication maps and all 3,243 determinant triples in the declared contexts.
- All 64 coefficients of a nonlinear covariant tensor fixture; raw-input and missing-transpose controls change fifteen and eight coefficients. Five invalid domains reject; four named semantic discriminators pass.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/nonfrobenius-rectangular-characters/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/nonfrobenius-rectangular-characters/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonfrobenius-rectangular-characters
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/nonfrobenius-rectangular-characters --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the prefix. Expected markers are `PASS_NONFROBENIUS_RECTANGULAR_CHARACTERS no_new_kappa`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The two registered argument lists took 0.375 and 0.482 seconds locally, below their 120-second limits. These are execution durations, not a performance comparison.

The registered runner, metadata/pins, exact committed bytes/modes/source ancestry, official export/input check and both read-only Git-free exported runs pass at `143491876f44d2bbf83bf52ae6c9fe5e9496a03c`. All seven exported files retain their bytes. The direct verifier uses only the standard library and writes nothing. The [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19380662) matches the delivered scope.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The quantified proof covers every finite field in the stated equal-cutoff family. The executable is bounded finite corroboration. Characteristic-power and unequal cutoffs, orbit recognition, chart/transporter recovery and physical coefficient preparation remain outside the result. It supplies no native caller, routing/restoration/precision/tape invoice, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem. The assigned card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side result; its physical-mechanism acceptance gate is unclaimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker build was needed or run.

## Open next questions

- Determine the tangent restrictions and exact character for unequal non-Frobenius cutoffs, starting with K[x,y]/(x^2,y^3). A complete lift argument for the changed relations is missing.
- Recognize the promised equal-cutoff tensor orbit and recover a multiplication chart. Begin with a unital table and its radical generators; no certified recognition or physical coefficient bill is supplied here.

## Related open work

- [PR6578](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6578) counts automorphisms and tensor symmetries in the Frobenius-power family. This computes determinant images for non-Frobenius relations and does not extend or replay that count.
- [PR6422](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6422) constructs least-subfield norm witnesses for the residue-field determinant interface. This needs only constant units in a split local algebra and computes no minimum witness field.
- [PR6464](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6464) reconstructs unital multiplication tables from a promised tensor without field enumeration. This supplies the determinant character once the different non-Frobenius algebra class is promised; recognition and chart recovery remain separate.

No competing open result on this non-Frobenius determinant image was found in the refreshed body and main/general-family searches. No additional computations checked another contribution.

The completion refresh listed 212 account open PRs and read the six other open submissions created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-11-03T18:19:17Z: PR6677, PR6678, PR6679, PR6680, PR6681 and PR6683. They concern reader coefficients, scalar preparation, clean checkpoints, finite-replay implementations and mirror windows. None studies this non-Frobenius determinant image or reports a competing value. The three related multiplication-tensor entries above remain applicable. No extra scientific computation checked another contribution.

## CI notes

CI did not certify this result. At exact head `143491876f44d2bbf83bf52ae6c9fe5e9496a03c`, [run 41694097281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41694097281) was cancelled by the workflow's ten-minute timeout while `plan` was still executing `actions/checkout`. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41694097281/job/126119938762) ran from 2026-11-03T18:28:10Z to 18:38:14Z. Python setup, onboarding tests and package selection were skipped; the scientific replay job was skipped. No package check ran in CI. This is a checkout infrastructure timeout, not a package test failure.

Two other recent pull-request runs show the same cancelled checkout: [run 41696887381](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41696887381/job/126129661142) and [run 41702891238](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41702891238/job/126150496321).

Verification is local only: the normal and optimized exact checks, both registered commands, metadata/source pins, committed-byte/mode/source-history preflight, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free exported replays listed above passed at this head. These local checks support the scoped result; hosted CI, independent human review and formal proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. Six new files and an opt-in bounded replay. Shared code, predecessor evidence and the selected frontier are unchanged.
